messages:
samir: Heads-up — staging console showing +350KB on main bundle after yesterday's chart component change. Landing page FCP jumped.
julia: ugh. which change? the new chunk-splitter PR? :grimacing:
max: yes, PR #482 — switched to dynamic import for ChartWrangler but I accidentally imported the whole d3 bundle inside the component instead of the smaller modules.
nora: can you paste the bundle-analyzer output? want to see which files blew up.
samir: pasted quick snippet from analyzer:
```
+ dist/main.js  ->  4.2MB  (before: 3.85MB)
  - chart-wrangler.chunk.js  +360KB  (d3-scale, d3-axis, d3-shape duplicated)
  - locale-data.chunk.js  +80KB (date-fns locales pulled unexpectedly)
```
max: ahhh — I also added date-fns/locale import to format ticks, but it pulled full locale pack because of how we import `format` vs `formatWithOptions`.
julia: that explains the FCP regression. Did the split result in extra HTTP requests or just bigger bytes?
kevin: both — chunk count +1 and chunk size larger due to duplicate node_modules copies. Looks like our webpack dedupe failed because of symlinked packages in local dev.
samir: build-bot reports several duplicate dependencies:
```
build-bot: duplicate-package-checker:
 - d3-scale found 2 copies (node_modules/d3-scale, packages/chart-lib/node_modules/d3-scale)
 - date-fns found 3 copies
```
nora: can we short-term revert the dynamic import? reverting would restore previous bundle size and buy time.
max: I'll open a revert PR if we agree. But we should also fix the root cause — ensure chart-lib exposes smaller submodules and update our import style.
julia: Also we need telemetry changes: surface bundle change to console health dashboard and create an alert for >10% bundle increase per deploy.
kevin: agree on alert. Right now our deploy pipeline only checks server artifacts. We should add a step
```
ci: yarn build:analyze && node scripts/check-bundle-threshold.js --max-delta 0.1
```
and fail deploy if exceeded.
samir: good. who will own the quick revert + alert?
max: I'll do the revert PR and fix imports in a follow-up. ETA 2 hours for revert.
nora: I'll own the CI/alert change. Will add a telemetry metric: console.bundle.size.bytes tagged by commit and env, and a Grafana panel.
julia: I'll draft a tiny playbook for oncall about bundle regressions — where to look (bundle-analyzer, duplicate-package-checker, yarn why), and add it to eng-platform runbook.
kevin: note for longer term — we should enforce single source-of-truth for chart deps and consider peerDependencies for chart-lib to avoid duplicates.
samir: thanks everyone. max — ping when revert is merged, then we'll run a smoke test on staging and watch metrics.
build-bot: deploy status: staging build started for commit abc123 (max) — will post artifacts when done :rocket:
max: revert PR opened: #499 — small change to import from 'd3-scale/src' and remove date-fns locale import. Running CI now.
samir: nice. after revert + CI, run `curl -s https://staging.console/health | jq .bundle` and post numbers.
julia: :thumbsup: also adding a checklist item to PR template: "did you run bundle-analyzer and confirm no >10% delta?"
kevin: good call. put that behind a required check.
nora: alert + grafana panel created (stage): https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/bundle-size — will hook to ops slack channel if threshold breached.
max: CI passed, revert merged. running staging smoke now.
samir: staging smoke: before revert bundle 4.20MB, after revert 3.88MB. FCP back to expected range. monitoring for 30m.
julia: adding notes to the rollout UX doc: when a front-end chunk regresses, tie deployment to automatic rollback policy for critical pages.
kevin: follow-up action items: 1) enforce bundle delta check in CI (nora) 2) PR template change (julia) 3) chart-lib dependency hygiene (max) 4) alert/grafana (nora) 5) run repo-wide dedupe sweep (samir).
samir: assigning actions in trak: https://trak.redwood/team/eng-platform/board/issue/987
build-bot: monitoring alert: bundle size delta spike cleared for staging — no alert fired in ops channel.
max: will schedule time tomorrow to refactor chart imports and run `npm dedupe` across monorepo.
nora: thanks all. closing thread when smoke window ends.
samir: closing in 25m if stable. great response time everyone :heart:
